contexts.text: They thus not only defile genuine love or charity, but also pervert it.
These things are darkness and defilements...
Nor have they denied their spiritual life by the grossnesses from honours and riches.
Through the understanding, the love... sees what the evils are which pollute and defile the love.
Who have not defiled their garments () = who are in truths, and have not defiled their worship through evils of life and the falsities thence.
These are they who have not been defiled with women () = that they have not adulterated the truths of the Church, and defiled them with falsities of faith.
The evil obstruct this influx by... spiritual defilements...
These are they who have not been defiled with women = those who have not falsified the truths of the Word.
